notes: Page 2 of the CHN newsletter archive — ten issues, June 2025 through January 2026, read in full. Eight are monthly Neighborhood News issues; two (the 11 May 2025 meeting reminder and the 22 November 2025 year-end appeal) are one-page announcements with no historical content. Three recurring features carry most of the addresses: the city assessor's 1976 block photographs, reprinted a block at a time; researched articles on a single building or corner; and remembrances. The assessor's photograph lists are captions only — a street number and the make of a car parked outside — and are not extracted except where a caption states a fact about the building.

coverage.remaining: Pages 4 and 5 of the archive (2024 and earlier, 18 issues) remain unread. Page 3 was read in the same run as archive-page-3.
coverage.note: Ninety-six numbered-address mentions, of which sixty-eight are bare captions in the 1976 assessor photograph lists for Blocks 2651, 2653, 2656, 2657 and 2660 — a number and a car, no statement about the building. The February 2025 issue names three earlier articles (March/April, June and August 2024) on Denis Kearney, the 4499 17th Street grocery and Ruth Asawa's Saturn Street house that are on unread archive pages.
